name: Martech Medical Products Inc
old_description: To be the leading solution provider for every customer we serve. To drive sustainable growth of our business through the continued investment in our people, technology and quality while delivering world class products and services.
about:
Founded in 1978 in Harleysville, Pennsylvania, Martech Medical Products Inc. began as a supplier of high-quality extrusions and molded components. The company grew by addressing manufacturing challenges ranging from the smallest epidural catheters to early hemodialysis catheters.

Today Martech operates three manufacturing and engineering facilities totaling 200,000 square feet and employs over 2,000 people across its East site in Harleysville, PA, and its West site in Mexicali, Mexico. Its integrated capabilities span R&D, project management, 3D printing, tool design, extrusion, molding, tipping, printing, coating, drilling, assembly, packaging, sterilization, finished catheter production, machining, and silicone product manufacturing.

The company serves top medical device manufacturers worldwide, providing concept-through-production services that smaller firms lack and larger firms prefer not to handle internally. Customers rely on Martech for custom silicone components, catheter systems, and other precision medical devices.

Martech differentiates itself by keeping tool design and fabrication in house, offering customization across its entire product line, and integrating every phase from design conception through FDA validation, assembly, and shipping to reduce cost and lead time compared with market standards.
